summary: Kerb opposite a park where cars park; homes about 25 m or more away on this side.
reasons: Homes 14 m away just past 50 m

best_section.where: North kerb of Marmion Parade, opposite the park, a short way from the west junction

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwelling 25 m away at 23 m along, and 43 m at 40 m; park and trees across the road. Houses 9 m at the start and 14 m beyond 50 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street between two junctions.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Homes within 14 m either side of the section
sun_shade: Park trees to the south shade the road in the afternoon; open to the east.
